current_grouping: Subpart H – Command and Control Data Link

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H – Command and Control data link
versions.text:
See AMC.1605 and AMC.1605 (b)
(a) The command and control data link must be protected against electromagnetic interference (EMI).
(b) Each command and control data link must be protected in such a way to prevent electromagnetic vulnerability (EMV).
(c) The command and control data link electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) must meet USAR.1431.
(d) The command and control data link, as system must comply with USAR.1309 requirement.
(e) The command and control data link must be designed to be protected against electrostatic, lightning and EME hazards at a level agreed with the Certifying Authority.
